details: Cryptocurrencies, including Bitcoin, have experienced extended losses and reached multi-month lows, primarily driven by escalating geopolitical tensions in the Middle East and increased expectations for the US Federal Reserve to maintain higher interest rates. The renewed uncertainty surrounding the Iran situation and recent robust US labor market data have fostered a "risk-off" sentiment among investors, leading to a rotation out of riskier assets. This environment has also contributed to significant outflows from crypto exchange-traded funds (ETFs). Analysts suggest capital is shifting towards high-momentum artificial intelligence (AI) stocks and other traditional financial assets.
title: Geopolitical Tensions and Hawkish Fed Pressure Cryptocurrency Markets
